sections.title: History
sections.content: During the mission to slay Ragruvord, Fadahl receives a message from a disciple about the dissenters who intend to harm Karna Masta. Claire, along with her twin-brother and Fadahl, choose to go back to aid Karna Masta. Shortly after they arrives at the battlefield, they fought the Oracle Knight and his party. During the fight, the same disciple who gave a revelation to Fadahl launches an attack to Colt. She throws herself to protect her brother from the attack, taking her life as the cost.

{{incomplete}} {{Character |name = Claire |image = [[File:navi chara65 0.png|300px|center]]
''Artwork from [[Grand Quest]]'' |element = Fire |gender = F |eyes = Red |hair = Blue |skin = Fair |gamedebut = Lizeria |currently = Grand Gaia (deceased) |relatives = {{c|Colt}} (younger twin brother) |counterpart = [[Claire]] }} '''Claire''' is one of the Sacred Guardians of Meirith devoted into protecting the Holy Emperor Karna Masta. She is the older twin sister of Colt, who is also a Guardian. ==History== During the mission to slay Ragruvord, [[Fadahl (character)|Fadahl]] receives a message from [[Melord (character)|a disciple]] about the dissenters who intend to harm Karna Masta. Claire, along with [[Colt (character)|her twin-brother]] and Fadahl, choose to go back to aid Karna Masta. Shortly after they arrives at the battlefield, they fought the [[Ark (character)|Oracle Knight]] and his party. During the fight, the same disciple who gave a revelation to Fadahl launches an attack to Colt. She throws herself to protect her brother from the attack, taking her life as the cost. ==Character==
